source_boundary: Locally attributed integration review plus the linked hosted CI log; local pre-fix observations are not a retained complete Git snapshot.

observations.problem: Expected compiler pin was checked after executing the captured compiler.
observations.observation_source: local integration review of the initial layer2 implementation

observations.prevention: Wrong-pin marker regressions assert the selected compiler never executes; snapshot error outcomes are typed, not inferred from message substrings.

observations.repair: Disable abbreviation in ontology-context CLI; keep wrapper workspace override checks.

observations.problem: Native launcher test fixture assumed source/.venv exists on hosted CI.
observations.repair: Use the active Python environment via sys.prefix rather than a repository-local virtualenv.
